hook.name: PairPadMemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by all graduated PairPad meme pools. On every swap, afterSwap extracts a protocol fee plus a creator tax from the unspecified output currency via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Accumulated memecoin-denominated fees are later batch-converted back to the quote currency via an internal swap, then split among protocol, creator, and a buyback-and-lock vault.
